strings.1. Проверить изменение организации автоб: 1. Check the change in bus service arrangements. 2. Check the legal basis for publicly posting the applicant's telephone number and medical information.
The bus near my home now runs much less often. Also, a district institution posted my telephone number and health information on a public page. I put both issues in one letter. Do I now have to write two new ones?
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В реальной работе доступ к приложению ог: In real work, access to the attachment is restricted. Medical information and the telephone number are not reproduced here.
strings.В учебной модели транспортный вопрос пер: In the training model, the transport question goes to Moscow's relevant authority, while protection of the data subject's rights goes to the authority responsible for that field. Official names and powers are checked separately.
strings.Вернуть письмо для обязательного разделе: Return the letter so the applicant must split it personally.
strings.Вести контроль результата отдельно по ка: Track the result separately for each question
strings.Второй предмет связан с распространением: The second subject concerns dissemination of personal data.
strings.Выполняйте действия в пределах своей рол: Act within your role. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Выслушайте обращение и уточните факты. Н: Listen to the appeal and clarify the facts. The case title does not determine which actions are correct.
strings.Гражданин всегда обязан переписать неско: The citizen must always rewrite several new submissions.
strings.Да. Ответ только про автобус не решит во: Yes. A reply only about the bus will not resolve the publication issue.
strings.Два самостоятельных вопроса с разной ком: Two independent questions under different areas of competence.
strings.Для решения о прекращении переписки учит: A decision to end correspondence takes account of repeated prior substantive replies, absence of new arguments or circumstances, and statutory conditions. Letter count alone is insufficient.
The supplement has been added to the case file.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Закрыть весь файл по полученному транспо: Close the entire file on receipt of the transport reply.
strings.Закрыть оба вопроса после первого ответа: Close both questions after the first transport reply
strings.Запрос информации о деятельности власти: A request for information on public-authority activities
strings.Заявитель просит рассмотреть оба вопроса: The applicant asks for both questions to be reviewed.
strings.Источник подтверждает именно выбранное д: The source supports the specific action selected.
strings.Как устроен предмет обращения?: How is the subject of the submission structured?
strings.Компетенция первого выбранного адресата: The first selected recipient's competence automatically covers the whole letter.
strings.Контроль относится к каждому поставленно: Oversight concerns each question raised, not merely the number of replies received.
strings.Копии обращения направляются соответству: Copies of the submission are referred to the relevant competent authorities; results are checked for each question.
strings.Мой телефон рядом с медицинскими сведени: My telephone number next to medical information. I attached a fictional copy separately.
strings.Найденная страница заменяет проверку обс: The page found replaces verification of the facts of the case.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check its applicability. A source page does not replace justification of the decision.
strings.Найдите основание направления копий разн: Find the basis for sending copies to different competent authorities. A citizen cannot be made to rewrite each request separately merely for the reception office's convenience.
strings.Найдите правило направления обращения, е: Find the referral rule when a submission's questions fall within several authorities' competence.
strings.Направить копии соответствующим компетен: Refer copies to the relevant competent authorities, separating the questions and necessary attachments.
strings.Нарушение прав при обработке данных може: Violations of rights in data processing may be challenged before the authorised body or a court. Asking the data controller to remove a publication does not make it an independent supervisory body.
strings.Необоснованное распространение чувствите: Unjustified dissemination of a sensitive attachment.
strings.Номер части статьи 8 для нескольких комп: Number of the part of Article 8 for multiple areas of competence
strings.Обращение отсутствует, пока гражданин не: There is no submission until the citizen rewrites it as two separate letters.
strings.Обращения субъекта о соответствии обрабо: A data subject's appeals about processing being consistent with its purposes are considered by the authorised federal body protecting personal data subjects' rights. The data controller and supervisory body are different actors.
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения письменного обра: The general written-appeal consideration period is tied to registration. It is not a universal deadline for construction, repairs or pollution removal.
strings.Одно письмо — несколько компетенций: One letter, several areas of competence
strings.Орган обеспечивает объективное, всесторо: The body ensures objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, requests materials where needed and provides a substantive reply. An appeal does not replace a budget decision.
strings.Отдельно проверить второй маршрут; один: Check the second route separately; one reply does not resolve both questions.
strings.Официальное происхождение позволяет прим: An official origin allows the material to be applied to any issue.
strings.Первый предмет – организация автобусного: The first subject is bus service organisation.
strings.Передавать приложения только в необходим: Refer attachments only to the necessary extent and within the recipient's competence.
strings.Передать всё только транспортному органу: Send everything only to the transport authority and treat the data issue as resolved.
strings.Письменное обращение поступило в приёмну: A written submission was received by the reception office of a Moscow executive authority. It contains two independent questions. Fictional materials without real personal data are attached. The subjects and areas of competence must be separated.
strings.По обоим вопросам нужен результат?: Do you need a result on both questions?
strings.Подготовить направление копий обращения: Prepare referral of copies to the competent authorities
strings.Помощник: «Для удобства прикрепим медици: Assistant: ‘For convenience, let us attach the medical information to every outgoing letter.’
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Потребовать новое обращение по персональ: Demand a new submission about personal data without checking referral of the old one.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.При маршрутизации требуется минимизация: Referral requires minimising disclosure. Convenience of distribution is not an independent legal basis.
strings.При нескольких вопросах нужно обеспечить: When there are several questions, ensure that each is reviewed rather than automatically requiring new submissions.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
strings.Проверить регистрацию и выделить оба воп: Check registration and identify both questions
Check whether the follow-up actions are complete.
strings.Прошу проверить организацию движения гор: I ask for the city bus service arrangements to be checked; this is not a dispute over a fine or tickets.
strings.Разграничить доступ к чувствительным при: Limit access to sensitive attachments according to need
Send every attachment to every authority.
strings.Разослать медицинское приложение всем ад: Send the medical attachment to every recipient without assessing necessity
strings.Рассчитайте последний день направления к: Calculate the last day for referring copies to multiple competent authorities. This is not the date of the final reply on each question.
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
strings.Сохранён самостоятельный ранее поставлен: This is a retained standalone scenario supplied earlier, not a new variant in this release.
strings.Только транспортный вопрос, остальной те: Only the transport question counts; the rest of the text is outside the submission.
strings.Транспортный орган ответил по движению а: The transport authority replied about the bus service. Review of the personal-data question has not yet been confirmed.
strings.Уведомить заявителя о маршрутах рассмотр: Notify the applicant of the review routes
strings.Удалить чувствительное приложение из дел: Delete the sensitive attachment from the file without preserving it.
strings.Установить компетентного адресата для ка: Identify the competent recipient for each question
strings.Учебная модель. Принимаете обращение и г: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
strings.Часть 4 статьи 8 относится к нескольким: Part 4 of Article 8 concerns multiple areas of competence. Part 3 concerns forwarding according to competence, but does not contain this specific rule about copies.
